chapter_meta_description: Chun Xiaoman sees her own face for the first time as Li Huowang disguises his group as an opera troupe. A punch to an old man tests the boundary of reality in Chapter 195 of Dao Gui Yi Xian.
og_title: The Art of the Opera Mask
og_description: Li Huowang's group becomes a traveling opera troupe. But the most stunning transformation is Chun Xiaoman's first look in the mirror.
